title: Goblins Stole My Panties 👙
description:
Goblins Stole My Panties👙 is an adult fantasy visual novel with exploration elements, mini-games, and puzzle challenges set in a humorous medieval world.

You play as a mischievous goblin who finds himself under a strange curse. To break it, he must travel across the kingdom, interact with various characters, complete different tasks, and collect a rather unusual set of trophies along the way.

During your journey you will explore multiple locations, talk with characters, solve puzzles, and take part in small interactive mini-games that unlock new encounters and scenes.

The game combines light adventure gameplay, story-driven progression, and a large amount of adult-themed content presented through illustrated scenes.Features:
🏰 medieval fantasy setting with multiple locations to explore
🔞 numerous adult scenes and mature-themed interactions
🧩 puzzle challenges and mini-games
👙 collectible trophies tied to character encounters
📖 story-driven progression with humorous dialogue
🎨 illustrated character scenes and fantasy environments
description_short: A humorous adult fantasy adventure where you play as a cursed goblin exploring a medieval world. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, meet unique characters, and unlock plenty of spicy illustrated scenes while collecting unusual trophies. 😏
